coordinate_space: Original source pixel coordinates; x/y inclusive, w/h lengths; equivalent right/bottom are exclusive.

bounds_policy.method: Read-only per-cell alpha measurement; no pixel editing or cropped image exports.
bounds_policy.reason: Alpha > 0 has extremely faint tails spanning cell gutters. Alpha > 8 and alpha > 32 subject bounds differ by at most a few source pixels. The main boxes deliberately describe visible subjects, not all nonzero alpha.

merchant.clipping_note: Main atlas box includes the visible subject plus padding, but excludes very-low-alpha tails; it is not an alpha-lossless full-support crop.

logical_display_targets.fit: contain / preserve source aspect ratio; do not stretch each bbox to a square
logical_display_targets.status: Intended logical display sizes only; not verified native pixel grid or export sizes.

limitations: Not hard-alpha sprites: all visible pixels have alpha below 255 and edges include partial alpha.
The generated layout is not an exact equal-cell sprite grid; use the recorded measured rectangles.
Read-only source rectangles do not remove soft edges, quantize color, clean noise or establish an exact common pixel grid.
The left character extends slightly beyond the requested left-third line; the measured inspection boundary uses x=600 to include the complete subject.
